decision: Require the complete-unit native receipt to bind every deterministic successful output, rather than accepting result.json plus an internally asserted hash inventory.
gap_closed: The prior complete-unit plan declared only actionmesh/unit-output/result.json. Raw generator outputs, all three control arms, all official scorer CSV/summary/backend records, copied official sources and resource logs therefore lacked direct native-receipt membership.
successful_output_classes_bound: complete result and generation/scoring execution logs
generation deformation arrays, report, sequence, 16 GLBs and grid_normal.mp4 preview
three control reports and sequences plus body poses
three official raw CSVs, summaries, backend records and subprocess logs
six copied official evaluator source files
failure_policy: A natural failure may retain a partial prefix and a failed attempt. It must not fabricate missing successful outputs or be promoted as a completed unit.
next_executable_step: Local reruns whole-suite software acceptance at the delivered revision, completes snapshot/dataset-semantics/unit-manifest admissions, source-inspects the emitted default-BF16 plan and then executes its exact harness digest on the single physical GPU.
